verdict.rationale: Keycloak has no built-in automation or workflow engine in the evidence. Background automation is possible only with external tooling: kcadm.sh scripting and the Admin REST API, client-credentials service accounts for unattended machine access, and the Kubernetes operator for declarative client management and automated realm imports. The community also reports that the API is inconsistent and hard to keep idempotent for automation. Missing for 10: native scheduled/triggered automations or workflows, event-driven actions configurable in-product, agent-oriented autonomous execution, and hands-on evidence of reliable unattended automation.
